body:
Independent full-shard review of worker06 at `d5a7613c931d45d057eaca7b5ec15280aca76c9e` found source-scope, component-provenance and completeness defects that must be resolved before campaign integration. The review covers all188 cases and100 selected payloads with three separate scientific reviewers and an independent final assembly review. It grants no owner, role or export approval.

The current ordinary successor is `1b3641853c7105b9091f81b5a9b19c99e8ed351e`, verified live. It addresses the known duplicate stock under #1207 and reports a separate Merck component-label correction. Re-review those exact successor bytes before retiring their findings. The remaining findings below need an immutable successor preserving published captures, payloads and native reviews.

| Finding | Defect | Required bounded outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W06-IR-002 | Contextual numbered pointers and generic labels resolve globally | Preserve each exact non-identifying label and provenance as REJECTED_LABEL; qualify preferred/ontology labels for JCM151/187/284 and R-P-MODIFIED-VITAMINS (JCM1158); retain explicit occurrence routing. Do not reject established named stocks or source-qualified names merely because they contain a number or see-below text. |
| W06-IR-003 | Merck108339 glucose component fails native reference-label validation | Use active component_name D-glucose for CHEBI:17634, preserve supplier spelling D(+)Glucose in assertion evidence, and rerun partonomy/exact-byte review. |
| W06-IR-004 | JCM977 stock Water is asserted as literal source input | Remove Water from literal transcription or explicitly represent and evidence the aqueous-solvent inference using method CURATED_INTERPRETATION and truthful curator/LLM attribution. Preserve unknown solvent detail, stock volume and glucose form; basal790mL water is not stock water. |
| W06-IR-005 | Acknowledged Water inferences use literal-transcription assertion method | Distinguish source-transcribed solute/concentration from inferred solvent. Use CURATED_INTERPRETATION with precisely attributed inference evidence and LLM provenance if retained, or omit untranscribed Water. MANUAL_CURATION requires actual human-supplied evidence and is not prescribed automatically. |
| W06-IR-006 | Positive JCM381-to379 evidence is misclassified as failed search | Bind A-E-CAPTURE-121 to the successful exact primary381 body with original timestamp/hash, retain381→379 context and index provenance, then refresh evidence bindings. D-glucose identity needs no correction. |
| W06-IR-007 | Bounded authorized product/stock curation is deferred as missing science | Provide bounded source/manufacturer-qualified proposals retaining UNKNOWN excipients/lot/SKU/doses/forms and explicit source discrepancies. EBIOS must remain tablets; TypeB must remain distinct from TypeA/pure casein; C.difficile BHI branch is Oxoid and must not inherit current SR0096E doses; RM may transcribe narrative molybdate while documenting parsed-table omission, unknown acid strength and solvent/final-volume details. Do not clear source/owner/export holds. |
| W06-IR-008 | Four failed receiving pages are classified as positive primary evidence | Relabel the four empty responses as unsuccessful_search, preserve original captures/access times, and enumerate receiving occurrences lacking an applicable recovered primary page. Preserve valid197 formulation/support and source-dose holds. Recover exact alternatives only if needed; do not use primary metadata as proof. |
| W06-IR-009 | TSY broth reasoning misstates frozen units | Correct the reasoning to the actual1000 ML_PER_L frozen value; retain the genuine unknown whole-broth formulation and do not infer constituents from its name. |
| W06-IR-010 | MediaDive1886 lacks a source bridge to JCM187 | Hold this KG source applicability unresolved; require an exact original collection/medium/recipe occurrence linking compound1886 toJCM187. Preserve independently supported CultureMech JCM187 contexts and their component evidence; remove or qualify unsupported KG backlink until then. |
| W06-IR-011 | YNB J240 quantity is misstated | Correct only J240 occurrence quantity in reasoning/evidence summaries to1g; keep exactSKU/grade unresolved. |
| W06-IR-012 | N-Z-Amine requirement overlooks known Sheffield typeA contexts | State known SheffieldtypeA subset explicitly and identify remaining uncertainty as catalogue/historical composition and unspecified other occurrences. Either perform authorized bounded source-qualified curation/review for that subset or mark that as deferred authorized curation; do not label already captured supplier/grade facts unavailable. Do not inferSigmaC7290 or universalN-Z-Amine equivalence. |

Primary examples: [JCM977](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=977) names20%w/v glucose without an explicit stock-solvent preparation; its790mL distilled water belongs to the basal medium. [JCM381](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=381) successfully links379; its original body must not be labelled a failed search. Failed receiving-page captures for JCM737/876/887/955 contain only “Nothing found”; the valid JCM197 formulation remains separate. [JCM969](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=969) and captured TOGO M3181/M2811/M2815 supply bounded product or stock facts while historical formulation details remain unknown.

The frozen TSY quantity is1000ML_PER_L, and the exact MediaDive J240 YNB occurrence is1g. The other inspected YNB recipes use6.7g. Captured compound1608 receiving contexts already identify Sheffield typeA; this does not establish SigmaC7290 or universal N-Z-Amine equivalence. A providerless “see Medium No.” pointer needs an actual collection/recipe bridge, not a matching number alone.

Preserve raw labels as provenance; retire resolving entries only where claim-specific evidence supports their non-identifying role. If a solvent inference is retained, use truthful CURATED_INTERPRETATION and actual LLM attribution, not fabricated human curation or literal recipe transcription. Keep genuine salt/form/SKU/dose/titrant/final-volume uncertainties and all88 downstream holds. Complete bounded authorized curation where evidence already settles its scope; do not force unresolved identities or collapse preparation differences.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w03/worktree/.temp/w06-published-head-independent-review-v1/`. Findings SHA256 `4626520a16f0b5e3729f6ffc630fba623e579742b3361cd68667de9c2598dd27`; assessment `ea688186e9507893bf98720bcaeaf3f86112600c18a390b411499db9c06c0a9c`; complete manifest `ee57931deef8638f9cb13a4f8bbc657bf5a1ef938eeb7e0a173775a2e8135a66`. The coordinator verified all5038 manifest files and read the exact grouped findings, reproductions and bounded fixes. The source evidence/case IDs/affected payload digests are enumerated in that ledger and must accompany the published successor.

Live all-state deduplication inspected675 issues and a fresh exact W06-IR search. #1207 remains the duplicate-stock tracker; #1201 is related completeness work, not a replacement for these named findings. Require per-finding dispositions, guarded isolated payload checks, complete case/occurrence accounting, native schema/partonomy and fresh independent final-head review. No maintained application, gate weakening, merge or downstream rebuild is authorized by this issue.
title: Resolve worker06 independent source-scope, component-provenance and completeness findings
